evidence_policy: Fictional local decision-audit packets, not market facts. Stipulated completed-analysis inputs may be used only for the requested rule audit; do not claim independent issuer verification.
run_protocol: Keep this transfer set separate from the original eight-case baseline. Integrity/unit checks do not execute an LLM.

Start a fresh model conversation with the canonical skill modules and explicitly request the preserved schema-2.4/rubric-1 audit. Provide only user_prompt and evidence_packet, not expected_checks or forbidden_claims. Evaluate new rubric-2 scoring separately with provisional-score-evaluation-cases.json.
Save the unedited response outside this repository; record model/version, skill commit, latency and excerpt-based human scoring.
A fabricated financial bridge, false hard-income pass, unsupported Strong Buy or generic waiting answer that contradicts the explicitly supported entry conditions fails its case.

cases.user_prompt: Audit the current action on this fictional completed Full Analysis under the supplied assumptions. Give staged prices, the decisive action and conditions for a stronger action. Do not generate a new company report or invent holdings.

evidence_packet.facts: Price 40 USD, normalized N=4, credible Bear B=3.2, r_low=8%, r_high=10%. The completed operating/cash/policy/share bridge is stipulated reconciled, with no fallback and no veto; tax, cash election and capital access are supported. Required returns were derived independently of price. No investor income target is supplied.

Forecast Confidence Medium; Dividend Safety Acceptable. The stated principal-risk review passes only under these research assumptions: three-year Bear/Base/Bull net cash 9.6/12/14.4, exits 32/50/60, zero costs, no reinvestment. Exit yields and acceptance of Bear principal loss are analyst assumptions, not the user's risk tolerance.

expected_checks: Starter/add/strict reference prices are 50/40/32; signed distances from 40 are +25%/0%/-20%.
Give gradual accumulation under the stipulated complete Medium-confidence evidence, not a blanket wait for High confidence.
Strong Buy is unavailable: it needs the strict price plus High confidence and Strong safety.
Distinguish the modeled 20% Bear principal decline from +4% cumulative cash-inclusive return; do not invent position sizing.
forbidden_claims: Positive price headroom is guaranteed upside.

cases.user_prompt: Check the score and explain what happens if only the share price changes. Audit the supplied module evidence counts; do not invent new weights or an action from the Grade.

evidence_packet.facts: Seven module bands in order: yield 1 (13-15), stability 1 (12-15), cash coverage 1 (17-20), balance sheet 2 (8-11), allocation 2 (8-11), buyback discipline 2 (5-7), visibility 2 (5-7). Met refinement counts are 2,1,1,2,2,1,2, respectively. All bands have support; no cap other than module weights; no Structural Decline. No program makes the Buyback Quality label Not Applicable while stable ownership is still scored.

expected_checks: Use band floor + floor(band width times met checks /3), yielding 14,13,18,10,10,5,6.
Quality is 62/85, income 14/15, total 76/100 and Grade B; Dividend Quality is Medium.
Changing only price cannot raise quality points or automatically change the business role.
Unknown refinement evidence earns no bonus, without being treated as proven distress or a second veto.
forbidden_claims: An unexplained 99/100 is compatible with these module inputs.
No buybacks always receives zero or maximum points.
